text: 9月10日上午，商务部部长王文涛会见保加利亚副总理兼经济、投资和工业部部长普列夫，双方就中保、中欧经贸关系交换意见。王文涛表示，中方注意到，近年来欧盟营商环境不断恶化，《工业加速器法案》、《网络安全法》修订案、外国补贴调查等相关立法严重影响中国企业赴欧投资。近日，欧洲议会发布《工业加速器法案》相关报告，提出大幅降低电动汽车等重点领域投资审查门槛，在外资持股、转让核心技术等方面设置阻碍，并限制非欧盟企业参与公共采购。近期，双方正在中欧贸易投资磋商机制框架下展开密集谈判。希望保政府在欧盟内发挥积极作用，推动欧方坚持稳定、平衡的中欧关键贸易伙伴关系新定位，通过
text_en: On the morning of September 10, Commerce Minister Wang Wentao met with Bulgarian Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy, Investment and Industry Plevneliev, and the two sides exchanged views on China-Bulgaria and China-EU economic and trade relations. Wang Wentao said China has noted that the EU business environment has continued to deteriorate in recent years, and that relevant legislation such as the Industrial Accelerator Act, the revised Cybersecurity Act, and foreign subsidy investigations have seriously affected Chinese enterprises' investment in Europe. Recently, the European Parliament released a report related to the Industrial Accelerator Act, proposing to significantly lower investment review thresholds in key areas such as electric vehicles, setting up obstacles in areas such as foreign shareholding and transfer of core technologies, and restricting non-EU companies from participating in public procurement. Recently, the two sides have been engaged in intensive negotiations under the framework of the China-EU trade and investment consultation mechanism.
